item.title: Patel, McCormick warn foreign terror threats inside US grew during Biden years
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel said sleeper cell threats are "real" during a roundtable on fentanyl, border security and DHS funding hosted by Sen. David McCormick in Allentown.

item.title: California 4-year-old boy survives attack by coyote that bit and tried to drag him away
item.summary: A 4-year-old boy had seven puncture wounds after a coyote attacked him in Southern California. The repeat offender was later euthanized.

item.title: Gavin Newsom's wife says she gave her boys dolls to play with in resurfaced clip
item.summary: Jennifer Siebel Newsom's comments on giving dolls to her boys are spreading on X, reigniting debate over parenting, gender roles and culture war politics around the Newsoms.

item.title: Trump gives rare praise to persistent GOP foe after White House ballroom vote
item.summary: Trump gives a special shout out to Sen. Rand Paul after the fiscal hawk votes yes on plans for the estimated $400 million White House ballroom project.

item.title: Florida man charged with murder after allegedly stabbing woman to death in random attack in quiet neighborhood
item.summary: Authorities say Kersten Francilus, 25, randomly stabbed a woman to death in a South Florida neighborhood after going door to door asking odd questions.

item.title: NFL clears Rashee Rice of league policy violations after probe into ex-girlfriend's abuse allegations
item.summary: The NFL said Chiefs wide receiver Rashee Rice was cleared after an independent probe found insufficient evidence he violated the league’s personal conduct policy.

item.title: Artemis II astronauts nearly halfway to the moon; NASA shares stunning photos from Orion spacecraft
item.summary: The four Artemis II astronauts are nearly halfway to the moon since launching Wednesday, while taking some stunning images. NASA says the mission is going well.

item.title: UConn Final Four run could trigger a $50M furniture giveaway for Massachusetts-based Jordan's Furniture
item.summary: Massachusetts-based Jordan’s Furniture faces a $50 million payout tied to a bold promotion if both UConn’s men’s and women’s basketball teams reach their respective title games.

item.title: New York Times goes viral for erroneous print headline on Trump's NATO exit threat
item.summary: The New York Times went viral for botching the name of NATO in a print headline about President Donald Trump's ongoing threat to the treaty organization.

item.title: Stephen A Smith backs Trump attending birthright citizenship case
item.summary: Stephen A. Smith weighed in on President Trump attending Supreme Court arguments on birthright citizenship, saying he doesn’t blame the move and calling the issue significant.
